notes.title: EVAC Bravo Update 2
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Thanks for playing the Bravo so far! Here's an update to keep it fresh. We'll have more for you soon!
-Updated Health and Damage system with new sounds and visual feedback. Cockpit now flashes red at low health and displays visual damage.
-Added Hitmarkers and Killmarkers that change color depending on what you're firing at. Extra satisfying sound effects.
-Added NOS and Cargo Hook to the Flite Manual- Press F1 to access.
-Updated Heli sound and Heli Damage Sound. Muffled when in cockpit, more attack when in third person.

[b]-Enlarged your Pilot.[/b]
-Fixed Radio Tower parts being extremely heavy.
-Changed Minigun Sounds
-Fixed Survey Link
-Fixed Space Bar not working on button mash
-Fixed Flak Turret being extra chunky (twice as heavy as it was supposed to be).
-Reimplemented ramming damage- not very substantial, but it can be used to crash through crates.

notes.title: EVAC BRAVO Playtest LIVE
notes.content:
[url=https://discord.gg/SXVkjxga3f]Join our Discord to access the Bravo Playtest![/url]
We have been hard at work 
[u][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/u]
Character Customization - View your personalized character and chosen name from third person.
Cinematic Camera - Take screenshots and videos with a variety of filters and options.
Health System - Land anywhere, or destroy blue repair crates. Avoid death.
Cargo Hook - Pick up virtually any physics object, even enemy missiles.
Cargo Missions - Deliver precious cargo through perilous fights.
NOS - A speed boost, charged by flying low. 
HUD Messages - Track new happenings, receive mission updates, become informed.
Cockpit Cosmetics - Decorate your workspace.

[u][b]ADDED[/b][/u]
-5 new enemy types
Super Boa (VTOL Jet Bomber)
Mudskipper (Heavy Transport Gunship)
Machine Gun Turret
Missile Turret
Flak Turret

notes.title: New Aerial Threats in Development
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=AhlrnglsEyY;full][/previewyoutube]

We added two new aircraft to the worlds coolest helicopter game- the KN-73 Mudskipper, and the KB-200 Super Boa. Both aircraft are VTOL capable, and highly dangerous. These are TOP-SECRET!!! Best-in-class!!! State-of-the-Art!!!

Progress on EVAC has been steady, and fruitful! Make sure to subscribe to our youtube, and join the discord! Thanks for following us, and we can't wait to see you in the skies!

notes.title: Minor Fixes and Changes to Minimal Flight Assist
notes.content:
-Fixed Minimal Flight Assist Launching you to high heavens
-Tweaked Minimal Flight Assist to be more intuitive and responsive
-Removed Assisted, and Arcade flight Assist.
-Added a tower of barrels for you guys to blow up.

notes.title: Alpha Fixes
notes.content:
-Fixed Army Dudes failing to mount.
-Fixed Windowed mode crashing the game on certain machines.
-Fixed Audio default set to 0. Now defaults to 70%
-Fixed pausing on the HUB softlocking game.
-Added SteamDeck resolution preference.
-Fixed camera rotation bug upon destroying prison.

Thank you everyone for playing the Alpha! We are so happy with your positive response, and extremely grateful for your thorough bug reports!! You are all an integral part of the development of EVAC!!!
